purpose: Independent IBKR contract, recent completed-close, volatility and liquidity audit. Intraday or delayed snapshots are not inserted into the backtest.

SOXX.history_note: IBKR returned 1,000 completed RTH daily bars and corporate actions. The completed close is used only for parity checking.

synthetic_basket_policy.MAGS7: Quarterly equal-weight synthetic index from AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, AMZN, GOOGL, META and TSLA. MAGS is used as a recent implementation reference, not as a full-history substitute.
synthetic_basket_policy.MAGS10: Quarterly equal-weight Cboe Magnificent 10 proxy using MAGS7 plus AVGO, AMD and PLTR. No IBKR-listed ETF is assumed to provide full historical replication.

live_use_policy: Use completed daily closes for signals and the following regular-session open for execution.
Do not mix live or 15-minute delayed snapshots into completed-close research observations.
Before acting on a signal, compare the most recent adjusted close and corporate-action treatment with IBKR.
No order instruction is created by this research.
